description: Updates fields of one item by primary key and leaves fields absent from data untouched: a PATCH, not a replace. Use create_item for a new row, bulk_operations for many rows, delete_items to remove them. In versioned collections the published item is read-only, so pass version with a draft key to write into a draft; without it Directus refuses the write. Overwrites whatever the field held, so read it with get_collection_items first when the previous value matters. Returns the updated item.

version.description: Draft version key to write into. Published items in versioned collections cannot be edited directly.

name: update_item
